about: The ODM XML reader's reads of text files (ODM-1, P-ODMIN-1), through odm_xml::read by read_odm. Its refusals: documents outside the supported layout, values, namespaces, snapshot and metadata rules and XML 1.0, an option below its minimum, an archive name that holds no archive, and a source path that reaches no regular file (FILE-7), each one issue naming the source as given. Its reads: the clinical-item table of odm13.xml (three items of one form and group) and odm20.xml (two items whose outer group supplies the form columns), and of each one edited. Its US-ASCII cases read odm13_us_ascii.xml, written by hand as an export that declares US-ASCII and writes each character outside ASCII as a character reference, with two repeats of one item group, an explicit null, a present empty value and an absent one, and us_ascii, the reproduction of #4060; a specification's .xml input reads that document through save and is refused through build, as read_odm refuses it, and each byte offset is counted by hand in the document the case writes. Moved from odm_xml.rs. A refusal's test asserted its condition and a part of its message, so its case compares the condition and the context keys that part states: a reason whole, from the refusal's message literal the part belongs to; the element, attribute, value, definition or option the message names; or nothing more where the part was the condition's fixed text. A read's test asserted some columns, so it opts in with output_subset and its output names those columns, in table order, with every row; a value its test asserted for some rows is derived for the others from the document and the reader's projection, and a test that asserted only a row count states the whole table, derived the same way.
